Suitable Soil: Well-drained loam/clay loam; pH 6-7.5
Water Requirement: 4-6 irrigations (CRI, tillering, jointing, flowering, grain fill)
Pest & Diseases: Rusts (yellow/brown/black), karnal bunt, aphids, termites
Prevention Methods: Resistant varieties, timely sowing, seed treatment (Carbendazim), foliar fungicides
Description: Major rabi cereal, staple food crop of northern India.

Suitable Soil: Clay/clay loam, water-retentive
Pest & Diseases: Stem borer, gall midge, blast, bacterial blight, brown planthopper
Prevention Methods: Resistant varieties, balanced fertilization, need-based pesticide use, IPM
Description: Staple cereal, dominant crop of irrigated and rainfed lowlands.

Suitable Soil: Red, laterite, sandy loam, well-drained
Pest & Diseases: Blast, brown spot, stem borer, aphids
Prevention Methods: Resistant variety Indaf-7, seed treatment, timely sowing
Description: Nutritious rainfed cereal grown widely in Karnataka, hilly regions.

Suitable Soil: Sandy loam, well-drained; drought tolerant
Pest & Diseases: Shoot fly, blast
Prevention Methods: Seed treatment, timely sowing
Description: Short-duration drought-hardy millet, staple in Rayalseema.

Suitable Soil: Poor, shallow soils; drought/waterlogging tolerant
Pest & Diseases: Smut, blast
Prevention Methods: Seed treatment with fungicide
Description: Hardy minor millet grown in tribal/Bastar regions.

Suitable Soil: Sandy, sandy loam; poor drought-prone soils
Pest & Diseases: Downy mildew, ergot, smut, shoot fly
Prevention Methods: Resistant hybrids, seed treatment with Metalaxyl
Description: Hardy arid-zone cereal, key crop of Rajasthan/Gujarat.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam; pH 6-6.5
Pest & Diseases: Tikka leaf spot, rust, aphids, white grub, stem rot
Prevention Methods: Resistant varieties (TKG19A, ICGV86590), gypsum application, seed treatment
Description: Major rainfed oilseed of peninsular India.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam to clay loam; pH 6-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Aphids, white rust, alternaria blight, powdery mildew
Prevention Methods: Sesbania green manuring, timely sowing, resistant hybrids, wider spacing (45x15cm)
Description: Key rabi oilseed of northern/western India.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained loam to clay loam; pH 6-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Girdle beetle, stem fly, yellow mosaic virus, rust
Prevention Methods: Ridge tillage/broad bed furrow, resistant varieties, seed treatment with Rhizobium
Description: Leading kharif oilseed of central India (MP, Maharashtra).

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam to black soils; pH 6.5-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Head borer, powdery mildew, Alternaria blight, downy mildew
Prevention Methods: 150% RDF for equivalent yield, need-based pesticide, resistant hybrids
Description: Important oilseed grown across seasons in Karnataka/Maharashtra.

Suitable Soil: Deep black cotton soils, well-drained; pH 6-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Aphids, wilt, leaf spot
Prevention Methods: PSB/Azotobacter seed treatment, resistant varieties
Description: Drought-hardy rabi oilseed of Maharashtra/Karnataka.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam to red/black soils
Pest & Diseases: Semilooper, capsule borer, wilt, grey mold
Prevention Methods: 75% RDF+25% N(FYM)+Azospirillum+PSB, resistant hybrids
Description: Industrial oilseed crop, major in Gujarat.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam; pH 5.5-8
Pest & Diseases: Phyllody, leaf webber, powdery mildew
Prevention Methods: Foliar urea spray at flowering, resistant varieties
Description: Traditional kharif oilseed.

Suitable Soil: Poor lateritic/red soils, well-drained
Pest & Diseases: Cuscuta (parasitic weed), aphids, leaf webber
Prevention Methods: Pendimethalin pre-emergence + seed sieving, foliar urea
Description: Minor tribal-belt oilseed crop.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained loam to clay loam; pH 6-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Rust, wilt, aphids, bud fly
Prevention Methods: Resistant varieties (JLS-9, JLT-26, Kartika), timely sowing
Description: Rabi oilseed cultivated in late-sown conditions.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained loam to clay loam; pH 6.5-7.5
Water Requirement: Rainfed; irrigation at pod filling helps
Pest & Diseases: Pod borer (Helicoverpa), wilt, sterility mosaic
Prevention Methods: Raised bed sowing with band placement, resistant varieties, trap crops
Description: Major kharif pulse, long-duration legume.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam to clay loam; pH 6-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Pod borer, wilt (Fusarium), Ascochyta blight
Prevention Methods: Zero/minimum tillage for water conservation, resistant genotypes (KWR108)
Description: Leading rabi pulse of India.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam to loam; pH 6.2-7.2
Pest & Diseases: Yellow mosaic virus, whitefly, powdery mildew
Prevention Methods: Resistant varieties, seed treatment, timely sowing
Description: Short-duration pulse fitting multiple cropping systems.

Suitable Soil: Sandy to sandy loam, well-drained; drought tolerant
Pest & Diseases: Bacterial blight, Alternaria blight, aphids
Prevention Methods: Seed treatment, resistant varieties
Description: Drought-hardy arid legume, gum industry raw material.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam; pH 6.8-8.3
Pest & Diseases: Blight (Alternaria), wilt, aphids
Prevention Methods: Mancozeb spray at 40/50/60/70 DAS, soil solarization, Trichoderma
Description: Key rabi spice of arid Gujarat/Rajasthan.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained loam rich in humus; pH 6-6.5
Pest & Diseases: Soft rot, bacterial wilt, shoot borer
Prevention Methods: Bio-fumigation with cabbage/mustard refuse, ZnSO4/borax foliar spray
Description: High-value rhizome spice of hilly/high-rainfall tracts.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained loam to clay loam; pH 5.5-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Rhizome rot, shoot borer, leaf spot
Prevention Methods: Metalaxyl-Mancozeb drench, biocontrol with parasitoids
Description: Widely grown spice/dye crop, several disease-resistant lines available.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained forest loam rich in organic matter; pH 5-6.5
Water Requirement: High humidity, regular irrigation in dry spells
Fertilizer (NPK): 100% N as Azospirillum+FYM or P as phosphobacteria+FYM
Pest & Diseases: Rhizome rot, leaf blight, thrips, capsule borer
Prevention Methods: Resistant accessions, biofertilizer application, shade regulation
Description: High-value spice of Western Ghats/Northeast hills.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained lateritic/red loam rich in organic matter
Fertilizer (NPK): FYM + NPK as per vine age
Pest & Diseases: Foot rot (Phytophthora), pollu beetle, anthracnose
Prevention Methods: Trichoderma soil application, resistant rootstocks
Description: 'King of spices', perennial vine of Western Ghats/NE.

Suitable Soil: Deep, well-drained loam to clay loam; pH 6.5-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Red rot, smut, early shoot borer, pyrilla, woolly aphid
Prevention Methods: Bud-chip technology, Thiophanate methyl sett treatment, Trichogramma release
Crop Rotation: Ratoon-plant cane cycle; rotate with legumes periodically
Description: Major cash crop for sugar/ethanol; long-duration crop.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam; pH 5.5-6.5
Pest & Diseases: Orobanche, root grub, S. litura
Prevention Methods: Fluchloralin pre-emergence, neem cake, IPM with trap crops
Description: Grown for chewing/cigarette/bidi leaf in Gujarat, Karnataka, AP.

Suitable Soil: Deep black (regur) soils, well-drained; pH 6-8
Pest & Diseases: Bollworms, whitefly, mealybug, wilt
Prevention Methods: Bt hybrids, IPM (pheromone traps, neem oil), border row trap crops
Description: Principal fiber crop of central/south India.

Suitable Soil: Alluvial, well-drained loam; pH 6-7.5
Water Requirement: High soil moisture, retting needs standing water after harvest
Pest & Diseases: Stem weevil, semilooper, stem rot
Prevention Methods: Glyphosate/Butachlor for weeds, nail weeder
Description: Principal fiber crop of West Bengal/eastern India.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam, friable; pH 5-6.5
Pest & Diseases: Late blight, aphids (viruses), potato tuber moth, cyst nematode
Prevention Methods: Certified seed, paddy-straw mulching, drip fertigation, crop rotation with legumes
Description: Major rabi vegetable/tuber crop across India.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam; tolerant of poor soils
Pest & Diseases: Cassava mosaic disease, scale insects, root rot
Prevention Methods: Disease-free planting material, vermicompost/coir pith as FYM substitute
Description: Staple tuber crop of Kerala/Tamil Nadu, industrial starch source.

Suitable Soil: Moist, well-drained to marshy loam rich in organic matter
Pest & Diseases: Taro leaf blight, corm rot
Prevention Methods: Bio-intensive IDM package, resistant varieties
Description: Important tuber crop in eastern/northeastern India.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam; pH 5.8-6.7
Pest & Diseases: Sweet potato weevil, viruses
Prevention Methods: Marigold/yam bean as barrier crops, lime+FYM+NPK+ZnSO4 application
Description: Widely grown tuber crop, food-security value.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained loam rich in organic matter
Pest & Diseases: Collar rot, leaf blight
Prevention Methods: Organic/INM schedule with biofertilizers, IDM package
Description: High-yielding tuber crop, orchard intercrop.

Suitable Soil: Deep, well-drained alluvial to laterite soils; pH 5.5-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Anthracnose, hopper, fruit fly, powdery mildew, jelly seed disorder
Prevention Methods: Paclobutrazol for flowering, Imidacloprid+NSKE spray schedule, black plastic mulch
Crop Rotation: Perennial; intercropped in young orchards with legumes
Description: India's most important fruit crop ('king of fruits').

Suitable Soil: Wide adaptability; well-drained loam to clay loam
Seed Rate: Grafted plants, high-density double hedge row system
Pest & Diseases: Wilt, fruit fly, mealybug
Prevention Methods: Trichoderma viride soil application with FYM, bagging fruits
Description: Hardy fruit crop grown pan-India.

Suitable Soil: Deep, well-drained loam rich in organic matter; pH 5.5-7
Water Requirement: Regular irrigation, critical at fruit development
Seed Rate: Grafted plants; double hedge row planting
Pest & Diseases: Fruit and shoot borer, litchi mite, fruit cracking
Prevention Methods: Pheromone traps, Trico cards, Dicofol spray for mite, cleanliness of orchard
Description: Important subtropical fruit of Bihar/West Bengal.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam to loam; pH 5.5-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Citrus psylla, leaf miner, gummosis (Phytophthora), canker, greening
Prevention Methods: Imidacloprid/NSKE spray, biocontrol agents (Mallada, Tamarixia), streptomycin for canker
Crop Rotation: Perennial; mixed cropping with pepper/banana in NE India
Description: Major fruit group grown across multiple agro-climatic zones.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam; pH 5.5-7.5
Water Requirement: Drip at 0.75 CPE / micro-sprinkler at 1.0 CPE
Pest & Diseases: Citrus psylla, leaf miner, canker
Prevention Methods: Drip irrigation scheduling, biocontrol agents
Description: Popular mandarin hybrid of Punjab.

Suitable Soil: Deep, well-drained loam rich in organic matter; pH 6-7.5
Pest & Diseases: Sigatoka leaf spot, Fusarium wilt, banana bunchy top virus, stem weevil
Prevention Methods: Disease-free tissue-culture suckers, Carbendazim dip/drench, entomopathogen traps
Description: Major fruit crop, year-round cultivation across India.

Suitable Soil: Wide adaptability; deep, well-drained loam
Pest & Diseases: Leaf webber, bark borer, fruit fly
Prevention Methods: Clean cultivation, pheromone traps
Crop Rotation: Elephant-foot yam intercropped in sapota orchard
Description: Popular evergreen fruit tree, good for orchard intercropping.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter; pH 6-6.5
Pest & Diseases: Papaya ringspot virus, mealybug, foot rot, powdery mildew
Prevention Methods: Staged NPK application (100:25:25% by growth phase), disease-free seedlings
Crop Rotation: Short-duration orchard crop, rotated with vegetables
Description: Fast-growing fruit crop, high vitamin content.

Suitable Soil: Wide adaptability incl. marginal/alkaline soils
Pest & Diseases: Rust, bark eating caterpillar, fruit fly
Prevention Methods: Double hedgerow planting system, ground-storey intercropping
Description: Hardy fruit for marginal/rainfed lands; net return ~Rs 53,050/ha reported.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained loam to sandy loam; tolerant of saline/alkaline soils
Pest & Diseases: Bacterial blight, wilt (Ceratocystis), fruit borer, fruit cracking
Prevention Methods: Boric acid+zinc sulphate spray, resistant rootstocks, Trichoderma-based wilt control
Description: Semi-arid fruit crop, important in Maharashtra/Karnataka.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam to loam; pH 6.5-7.5
Seed Rate: Rooted cuttings on rootstock (110R, Dogridge, B2-56)
Pest & Diseases: Downy mildew, powdery mildew, thrips, mealybug
Prevention Methods: Weather-based disease forecasting/advisory, resistant rootstock selection
Description: Major fruit crop of Maharashtra (Nashik) grown on trellises.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained loam rich in organic matter; pH 5.5-6.5
Pest & Diseases: Scab, powdery mildew, woolly aphid, canker
Prevention Methods: High-density planting with pollinizers, need-based fungicide sprays
Description: Key temperate fruit of Himachal Pradesh/J&K/Uttarakhand.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam; pH 6-7.5
Water Requirement: Critical during nut development; mulching aids moisture
Pest & Diseases: Shot hole borer, brown rot, aphids
Prevention Methods: Half-moon/full-moon in-situ moisture conservation + plastic mulch
Description: Dry-temperate nut crop of Ladakh/Kashmir.

Suitable Soil: Deep, well-drained loam; pH 6-7
Pest & Diseases: Walnut blight, aphids, fruit fly
Prevention Methods: Wedge grafting in polyhouse/polytrench during mid-March for higher success
Description: Temperate nut crop of Himachal Pradesh/J&K.

Suitable Soil: Well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter; pH 5.5-6.5
Pest & Diseases: Grey mold (Botrytis), red spider mite, leaf spot
Prevention Methods: Polyhouse/polytunnel cultivation, resistant varieties (Chandler, Camarosa)
Description: High-value crop increasingly grown under protected cultivation.

Suitable Soil: Sandy loam/littoral sandy soils, well-drained; pH 5.2-8
Pest & Diseases: Root (wilt) disease, rhinoceros beetle, red palm weevil, bud rot, leaf rot
Prevention Methods: Trichoderma/Pseudomonas soil application, Mancozeb sachets in leaf axils, biocontrol of caterpillar
Description: Major plantation crop of coastal India.

Suitable Soil: Deep, well-drained loam rich in organic matter
Pest & Diseases: Koleroga (fruit rot), yellow leaf disease, spindle bug
Prevention Methods: Bordeaux mixture spray, mixed cropping with pepper/banana/citrus
Crop Rotation: Arecanut mixed with pepper, banana, citrus
Description: Important plantation crop of Karnataka/Kerala/NE India.

Suitable Soil: Sandy/laterite soils, well-drained; tolerant of poor soils
Water Requirement: Rainfed; irrigation in high-density plantings boosts yield
Pest & Diseases: Tea mosquito bug, stem and root borer, inflorescence thrips, anthracnose
Prevention Methods: Chlorpyriphos for stem borer, Triazophos/Profenofos for thrips, high-density planting
Description: Major foreign-exchange earning plantation crop of coastal India.

Suitable Soil: Composted substrate (not soil-grown); controlled cropping room
Water Requirement: Regular misting/humidity control, no field irrigation
Fertilizer (NPK): Compost-based nutrition (wheat straw + additives), no soil fertilizer
Pest & Diseases: Nil (indoor); rare cases dry bubble/wet bubble disease (Mycogone)
Prevention Methods: Neem oil/plant extracts against Mycogone, hygienic compost preparation
Description: High-value protein crop grown indoors year-round.

Suitable Soil: Soilless media (leaf mould, bark); epiphytic
Water Requirement: Regular misting, 25-50% shade with controlled water regime
Fertilizer (NPK): N (0.95%) and K (0.54%) rich nutrient solution at flowering
Average Yield: N/A (ornamental, sold as cut flowers/potted plants)
Pest & Diseases: Anthracnose (Colletotrichum), black spot (Alternaria)
Prevention Methods: Mancozeb+Carbendazim spray, 100% leaf mould media for best survival
Description: High-value ornamental grown under shade-net/greenhouse conditions.
